craft_notes: Sthāyin: becoming without yoga. Rows: seeing then being. Read aloud: liberation.

lines: Thus by mere rite the doer, made all of the Lord,
holds all doings with this very gaze,
sans chiefest ken and yogin sway —
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kriyākrameṇāpi parameśvarīkṛtasamastakārakaḥ tayaiva dṛśā sarvakriyāḥ paśyan vināpi pramukhajñānayogābhyāṃ parameśvara eva bhavati

reads_against.argmap: seeing all as Lord = becoming Lord
